name: @story/multi-engine-client
comment:dependencies: Only what `src/main.tsx` imports today. No `@mui/material` — every visual primitive comes through `@story/ui`'s barrel, so MUI stays the transitive detail of that package. No `@story/core`/`@story/data` either: a client that does not talk to a server yet has no use for the story runtime, and per REFACTOR_PLAN §3 the passage templates it will eventually render stay in SingleEngine until MultiEngine is actually built. `react`/`react-dom` are pinned to the same exact version as the other two apps and deduped by the root `resolutions` (§10 risk 3).
